title: The Adventure Begins
logline: When eager young Keen sails away from home and into a sudden storm, he discovers that courage is not looking fearless — it is leaping to help a friend while the fear is still in his paws.

orderedEvents.text: Tall flowers sway gently in the warm breeze. Some stretch high above the grass, with long soft necks and bright open petals full of pollen. FUZZBY and ZENNY weave between them collecting pollen from flower to flower. Tiny pollen sacks bounce on their back legs. Zenny works with smooth calm precision — neat, efficient, graceful. Fuzzby does not. He zig-zags wildly through the air, humming loudly to himself as he works.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…
He dips low into a flower, scoops up pollen — then overdoes it and spins sideways into a leaf. FWIP. He bounces back into the air and straightens up proudly.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: Nailed it.
Zenny glides up beside him. Watches him for a beat.

beats.storyBeat: At bee height in the flower field, Zenny’s graceful work is contrasted with Fuzzby’s full-throttle pollen chaos. His first crash into the leaf becomes his self-declared success, establishing that his comedy is not clumsiness alone but proud denial after impact.
beats.want: Fuzzby wants to look like a competent, important pollen collector.
beats.need: He needs to know he belongs even when his body betrays the performance.
beats.kidRead: Funny bee zooms, bonks, bounces back, and acts like it was perfect.
beats.adultRead: The anxious little performer is already covering failure with dignity; the laugh comes from recognition, not humiliation.
beats.emotionalIntent: Open with buoyant safety and instant character contrast, making the world playful before any storm threat enters.

beats.want: Keen wants to land, breathe, and orient himself among strangers.
beats.need: He needs physical support before introduction — a body saying he is safe.
beats.kidRead: Keen gets off Squeaky, wobbles, and the bears help him.
beats.adultRead: The first welcome is not a speech; it is someone stepping in before he falls.
beats.emotionalIntent: Let the rescue’s adrenaline settle into embodied care.

cuts.action: Squeaky glides into the shallows. Keen hops off onto the sand, stumbling forward. Laughing. Breathless. Soaked from head to toe.

His legs wobble. He nearly falls. Howey instinctively steps in and steadies him. The bears gather around him in a warm circle. SUNNY bounces excitedly. AMIE beams. Everyone curious, gentle, smiling. Keen looks around at them all.

orderedEvents.text: Fuzzby zooms right into Keen’s face.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: You rode a dolphin. Into a storm. On purpose?!
Keen blinks at him.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: …kind of?
Fuzzby slowly turns to the others. Points at Keen like he has discovered a legend.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: He’s amazing.
Zenny gently drifts in and pulls Fuzzby back by one leg.

orderedEvents.speaker: Zenny
orderedEvents.text: Give him space.
The others smile. Together:

orderedEvents.speaker: ALL
orderedEvents.text: Welcome to Crystal Cove! We’re the Crystal Bears!

beats.storyBeat: Fuzzby zooms into Keen’s face and mythologizes him instantly, while Keen’s modest uncertainty makes the legend funnier. Zenny pulls Fuzzby back and the whole group welcomes Keen properly.
beats.want: Fuzzby wants to celebrate the new hero at maximum proximity.
beats.need: Fuzzby needs Zenny’s boundary so admiration becomes welcome instead of overwhelm; Keen needs space to be received gently.
beats.kidRead: Fuzzby thinks Keen is amazing, gets too close, and Zenny pulls him back.
beats.adultRead: Community can over-love a newcomer; true welcome includes enthusiasm and room to breathe.
beats.emotionalIntent: Use comedy to soften Keen’s arrival and show the group’s warmth without crowding the feeling.

orderedEvents.text: What did you do?

orderedEvents.text: Just getting a message home to your Mum. To let her know you’re okay.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Thank you.
Aida gives him the smallest nod.

beats.emotionalIntent: Let the emotional payoff be communal, warm, and slightly funny, ending on belonging rather than ceremony alone.
